t: You're at the site of The Mangrove, a Caribbean restaurant on All Saints Road in Notting Hill. It opened in 1968 and closed in 1992. Its owner, Frank Crichlow, was a community activist and a central figure in the Notting Hill Carnival, and the restaurant was a base where activists, musicians and artists organised the event. It is also known for the trial of the Mangrove Nine, activists tried for inciting a riot at a 1970 protest against police targeting of the restaurant.
